articles.headline: Harry Kane makes England history with first-half double
articles.description: Harry Kane joins Gary Lineker as England's leading World Cup goalscorer with two first-half goals in the Three Lions' WC opener against Croatia.

articles.headline: World Cup Daily: England open against Croatia in Dallas
articles.description: It has officially been one week of 2026 FIFA World Cup action. Enjoy all the features, news, video analysis and color from around the competition.

articles.headline: Why one VAR rule for Lionel Messi, and another for Themba Zwane? - South Africa coach Hugo Broos
articles.description: South Africa will appeal the red card and three-match suspension handed out to Themba Zwane according to head coach Hugo Broos, who has questioned why Lionel Messi received different treatment.

articles.headline: Portugal boss Martinez: 'No sense' taking out misfiring Ronaldo
articles.description: Portugal coach Roberto Martinez brushed aside concerns, about both his team and star Cristiano Ronaldo 's goal-scoring drought following Portugal's frustrating 1-1 draw with Congo DR.

articles.headline: Portugal have a Ronaldo problem (again) after draw with Congo DR
articles.description: Cristiano Ronaldo will go down as one of Portugal and soccer's all-time best players, but it's becoming clear his team could be better without him.

articles.headline: World Cup VAR review: What rule change earned England penalty retake vs. Croatia?
articles.description: For the tournament, we are taking a look at the major incidents to examine and explain the process in terms of both VAR protocol and the laws of the game.
